info.name: HubSpot Analytics Events Access Tokens Companies API

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor for pagination to get the next page of results.

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma-separated list of property names to return.

items.docs: Returns a page of company records. Use the limit and after parameters to paginate through companies. You can also specify which properties to return using the properties parameter.
Creates a new company record with the provided properties. The request body should include a properties object containing the field values for the company you want to create.

params.name: companyId
params.description: The ID of the company to retrieve.

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma-separated list of property names to return.

items.docs: Returns a single company record by its ID. You can specify which properties to return using the properties parameter.

params.name: companyId
params.description: The ID of the company to update.

items.docs: Performs a partial update of a company record. Only the properties included in the request body will be updated; other properties will remain unchanged.

params.name: companyId
params.description: The ID of the company to archive.

items.docs: Archives (soft deletes) a company record by its ID. Archived companies can be restored using the HubSpot UI or API. This does not permanently delete the company from HubSpot.
Searches for company records using filter groups, sorts, and other query parameters. Supports complex filtering with multiple filter groups and operators for precise record retrieval.
